lines.text: Paul says people should regard him and Apollos as servants of Christ, and stewards must be found faithful.
Paul says the Lord judges him, and he tells them to wait until the Lord comes, who will expose the motives of hearts.
Paul says God displayed the apostles at the end of the procession, and the apostles are fools for Christ while the Corinthians are wise.
Paul writes to warn his beloved children, and he sends Barnabas, his faithful child in the Lord, to remind them of his way of life.
Paul says he will come shortly if the Lord is willing, and asks whether they prefer him to come with a sword or in love.
